Checksums: CRC-8/CCITT, CRC-16/ANSI (+LE), CRC-32, MD5.

Ports symphonia-core/src/checksum/{crc8,crc16,crc32,md5}.rs. Tables are generated at startup from the same polynomials rather than transcribed, and verified against the reference vectors in tests. CRC-8/16 cover FLAC frame headers/footers; CRC-32 covers Ogg pages; MD5 covers FLAC stream validation.

Types

Md5 = object
Standard MD5. Port of Symphonia's checksum::Md5.

CRC-16/ANSI, big-endian order (poly 0x8005, init 0). FLAC frame footers. Standard check ("BUYPASS" params): "123456789" -> 0xFEE8.
